title: Out and Back
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：out　|　正文 306 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 out 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Out, in 1962 the guide carried the map at the ledge, and everybody in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning: the guide had carried the map ② out before dawn, and nobody had asked a single question. The guide had come to the valley two days earlier, and spoke little of the valley he had left behind him.

The guidebook for July 1956 puts it plainer. The map was ③ out, and the traveller who kept it wrote of the map ④ out in the same line; nothing in the valley was ever left out for long in those days. The traveller wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every day thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ out, and ⑥ Out came the traveller who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the valley had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1969 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook. What the line asked for was that the map be found ⑦ out at the ledge, and that everybody be ⑧ out before the July rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried out.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1972 she carried the map ⑨ out in public when nobody else would, and ⑩ Out, she said in 1974, that was the part the valley never forgot; the guidebook still speaks of it out. She kept the map in the same ledge for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the valley never forgot how out it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 出去（句末状语，置于宾语之后：carried the map out，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 出去（作表语，说明处所或去向：the map was out）
C. adv. 在外（置于句首：Out, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 在外（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the map out）
E. adv. 在外（作介词宾语：from out）
F. adv. 在外（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Out came the traveller）
G. adv. 出去（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be found out at the ledge）
H. adv. 出去（be out 说明所在或去向：everybody be out before the rains）

answers.why: out 意为“在外”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Out, in 1962 …。
out 意为“出去”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had carried the map out。
out 意为“出去”，此处作表语说明那件小小的地图的去向或所在：was out。
out 意为“在外”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the map out。
out 意为“在外”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from out。
out 意为“在外”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Out came the traveller。
out 意为“出去”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be found out at the ledge。
out 意为“出去”，be out 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
out 意为“出去”，1972 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次搬出那件小小的地图，副词置于句末。
out 意为“在外”，母亲 1974 年那句话以地点状语开头：Out, …。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年，向导在崖台搬出那件小小的地图；山谷里人人都说那是头一回。（Out, …）
向导已经把那件小小的地图搬出出去。（… out …）
那件小小的地图当时就在出去。（was out）
旅行手册那一行写的是出去的那件小小的地图。（the map out）
叔叔是从出去回来的。（from out）
记录要求那件小小的地图在崖台被找出去。（be found out）

The guide had carried the map out before dawn.
